messages:
priya (PM): quick sync — product needs final PRD + RFC for the Optimize toolkit (batching / caching / quant recommendations). customer ask: reduce per-token cost by 30% for chat workloads w/ minimal latency regressions. timeline: ship alpha to a handful of customers in 6 weeks. @connor @maya can you confirm scope tradeoffs?

connor (Eng-ML): high level proposal: 1) recommendation engine that suggests batching + cache configs per workload; 2) quantization profiles + validation harness; 3) SDK / API for applying recommended profiles. out-of-scope for alpha: autoscale decisions, persistent multi-tenant kv-store.

maya (Eng-Platform): agree with scope but we need clear acceptance criteria. propose minimal viable acceptance: 
```
- end-to-end recommendation flow works on 3 real customer prompts
- <30% median token cost reduction on those tests OR no more than 10% p50 latency increase
- regression tests for quality with ±2% NLI pass-rate drop threshold
- rollout knob: can force fallback to baseline model per-route
```

priya (PM): nice. add product gating: at least one paying customer signs up for alpha and ops-runbook exists. also include documentation + quickstart.

leo (Solutions): flag from customer field — some customers need deterministic outputs, so quantization must have clear degrade/fallback. requirement: the recommendation must include an "explain" reason string and SAFE flag when we recommend lower-precision for non-deterministic endpoints.

connor (Eng-ML): edge cases we need on RFC: 
- very short-sequence chat (<=8 tokens) where batching harms latency;
- large context sessions where KV cache invalidation semantics differ per model;
- mixed-precision incompatibilities when using certain kernels.
we should add a fallback policy: prefer lossless options first (batching heuristics -> prefix cache -> quant for cold paths).

sam (SRE): ops constraints: load test plan + CI checklist. short sketch: run PW-based load tests on dedicated pool w/ 95th latency targets, run end-to-end canary to 1% of traffic, failover to baseline model on error rates >0.5%. Also capture cost delta per-minute during test.

priya (PM): acceptance checklist draft (short): docs, tests, runbook, canary plan, customer alpha sign-off, SDK examples. I'll put formal PRD skeleton tomorrow.

maya (Eng-Platform): quick note on UI/UX for internal customers: we need an annotation page showing suggested config, estimated cost delta, and confidence score. small mock acceptable for alpha.

connor (Eng-ML): quant validation harness idea: run prompt set + embedding similarity + response-sanity checks. thresholding done via NLI-style regression. keep thresholds configurable per-customer.

leo (Solutions): can we add an explicit acceptance criterion for reproducibility? e.g., ability to reproduce a recommendation run (seeded sim) and store config version. customers will ask for audit trail.

ci-bot: scheduled: optimize-toolkit/ci -> perf/regression job queued (ETA: 2d). :gear:

sam (SRE): also adding runbook step: emergency rollback command: `redwoodctl rollout set --model baseline --route <route>` (test in staging).

priya (PM): outstanding asks: @connor to draft RFC with heuristics + fallback policy, @maya to outline platform integration points + UI mocks, @sam to draft canary + test plan, @leo to collect customer acceptance criteria examples. please ack if you can deliver artifacts by EOW. :eyes:

connor (Eng-ML): ack, will drop RFC draft + sample heuristics by Thu.

maya (Eng-Platform): ack, will put platform integration doc + simple mock by Fri.

sam (SRE): ack, will add canary + rollback playbook by Fri EOD.

leo (Solutions): ack, will collect 2 customer acceptance templates and forward.

priya (PM): thanks — if no major objections, I'll merge these into the PRD and open RFC for review next week. :thumbsup:
